devcmd.name: DevCmd
devcmd.description: Interactive development CLI for scaffolding JavaScript, mobile, and Python projects with framework-appropriate defaults. Supports lifecycle commands (install, run, test, build, check, clean, reset), Android emulator and iOS simulator management, custom framework recipes, MCP server for AI agent integration, and shell completion.

devpad.name: DevPad
devpad.description: Native macOS menu bar utility for developers. Includes JSON/XML/SQL formatter, URL parser, QR generator and scanner, JWT decoder/signer/verifier, Regex tester, Hash generator (8 algorithms), Diff compare, Clipboard history with Pure Paste, and Drop Shelf for batching file drag-and-drop. Supports English and Vietnamese.

finhub.name: FinHub
finhub.description: Local MCP server for financial market data. Covers Vietnam stocks (price, intraday, OHLCV history, market indices), company financials, crypto spot and futures (funding rate, open interest), SJC gold price, Vietcombank forex rates, and price alerts with Telegram notifications. Automatic provider fallback across multiple data sources.
